newsitem.title: EGYPT: Misr Oil and Soap reduces dividend.
newsitem.headline: Misr Oil and Soap reduces dividend.

text.p: Misr Oil and Soap has cut its dividend for financial 1995/6 to 3.00 pounds from the 3.41 pounds proposed in December because government auditors adjusted its profits downwards, a company official said on Sunday.

The Central Audit Bureau calculated that the company's net distributable profit was about 24 million pounds ($7 million), rather than the 26.576 million the company had announced. That profit was a decline from 31.311 million in 1994/5.
The company announced on Sunday that its results improved in the first months of 1996/7, which began on July 1, and the dividend should be higher for the current year.
The company has six million shares and they closed on the Egyptian stock exchange last week at 29.56 pounds each.
The company will distribute the dividend from January 13.
